column1: # The checks of shell/short-var-store.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh.
# Each question reads the EFI variable of its VarName, of the store's Guid, and nothing shows a
# byte of the password in ShortVarPw

column3: any(.[]; .name == "Short numeric" and .answer == "5") and any(.[]; .name == "Short one-of" and .answer == "Disabled")

column1: # set refuses to write in a HiiDB that declares a password question

column3: . == {"error_message": "this HiiDB declares a setup password question; the UEFI Shell runs no setup browser, so no password is asked or checked; pass --bypass-setup-password to write anyway"}

column1: # unless --bypass-setup-password is given; the GET of its SUPPRESS_IF reads 5 from ShortVarA, which
# hides the CHECKBOX until ShortVarA holds 9

column3: . == {"error_message": "question \"Short checkbox\" is suppressed; also include suppressed questions to select it"}

column1: # the CHECKBOX writes ShortVarC, and the SET of its WRITE ShortVarB, which the ONE_OF answers
# set creates the missing ShortVarD of the UINT16 NUMERIC with the store's Attributes; dmpstore
# An ORDERED_LIST reads the 3 containers of ShortVarL, and set writes the variable whole
# A REF shows the EFI_HII_REF of ShortVarR, which set does not write; ArmVirt's console shows
# "§" as "?", so the check of the refusal compares it with "?" in its place

column3: .responses | length == 1 and .[0].question.answer == "QuestionId 0x0001, FormId 0x0001, FormSetGuid 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000000B00, DevicePath none"
(.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "cannot set question \"Short ref\": set does not write the EFI_HII_REF of a cross-reference question, the target of its link (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.4.10)"

column1: # The containers of UINT16 options take 2 bytes each, and a variable of another size than the

column3: .responses | length == 1 and .[0].question.answer == "<ValueUnavailable: EFI variable ShortVarM-8c78a505-baa0-4c4a-869f-000000000b01 holds 3 bytes; the question takes 2>"

column1: # An ORDERED_LIST as wide as ShortVarPw reads and writes none of the password

column3: .responses | length == 1 and .[0].question.answer == "<ValueUnavailable: its bytes hold a password>"
. == {"error_message": "cannot set question \"Short password list\": its items cannot be read, so set cannot keep those of hidden options: its bytes hold a password"}
